name: Švitrigaila's Grand Duchy
native: Švitrigailos Rusios Didžioji Kunigaikštystė (Švitrigaila's Ruthenian grand duchy)

predecessors.name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
predecessors.text: Polotsk, Vitebsk, Smolensk, Kiev and Volhynia, the lands of Švitrigaila's supporters

successors.name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
successors.text: Polotsk, Vitebsk, Smolensk, Kiev and Volhynia, the lands of Švitrigaila's supporters

ledger.x: 31 August 1432: Švitrigaila is overthrown in Lithuania and keeps the east.
1432: the east passes to Švitrigaila's side.
1438: Švitrigaila withdraws to Moldavia and the east returns to the Grand Duchy.

wars.name: Lithuanian Civil War (1432-1438)
wars.outcome: Sigismund Kęstutaitis, backed by Poland, defeated Švitrigaila, backed by the Teutonic Knights, at Wiłkomierz in September 1435; Švitrigaila withdrew to Moldavia in 1438; Sigismund was assassinated in 1440 and Casimir IV approved as grand duke.

certainty.note: The pages name the lands of the two sides by town and region only; no frontier between them is given.
